report.rationale: reproducing test FAILS on buggy and PASSES on fixed, and 2/2 reported example(s) reproduce, but 4 of 6 reported example(s) could not be evaluated on either revision, so those values remain unchecked
report.success_criterion: On the unmodified buggy commit 5faf9dff8f3f08462ce3e0f72b44731ca10ac291, with only the PR's test additions present, the reproduction run fails because the UTC->local shift silently wraps instead of raising OutOfBoundsDatetime (at least test_dti_utc_to_local_overflow, test_dti_utc_to_local_underflow and test_dti_utc_to_local_overflow_message_names_the_target_tz fail with 'DID NOT RAISE'); the same run passes once the fix commit f040cfd is applied.

examples.buggy_output_reported: No exception; the UTC->local shift is a bare add, so the wall time wraps by 585 years and tz_localize(None) returns a wrapped wall time.
Same wrap at the bottom of the range; the wall time below Timestamp.min wraps instead of raising.

examples.expected_output: pytest.raises(OutOfBoundsDatetime, match='Converting 2262-04-11 23:47:16 to Etc/GMT-9 overflows past')
examples.buggy_output_reported: No exception / wrapped value; message lacks the target tz and complains about a value that looks fine, e.g. 'Converting 1677-09-21 00:12:43 underflows past 1677-09-21 00:12:43.145224193'.
The tzlocal branch of the shift lacks the same guard, so the east-of-UTC wall time overflows by wrapping instead of raising.

examples.input: dti = DatetimeIndex(np.array([iNaT + 3600 * 10**9], dtype='i8').view('M8[ns]')).tz_localize('UTC').tz_convert(timezone(timedelta(hours=-1))); then dti.tz_localize(None) / dti.year / dti.floor('D') / dti.to_period('ns')
examples.buggy_output_reported: Wall time stores the NaT sentinel: tz_localize(None) and to_period('ns') silently return NaT and field accessors return -1.

examples.input: DatetimeIndex([NaT], tz=tz).is_normalized for tz in [None, 'UTC', 'US/Pacific', 'Etc/GMT-9', timezone(timedelta(hours=-1))]
examples.expected_output: False (add 'if utc_val == NPY_NAT: return False'; a bare continue would flip all-NaT arrays to True)
examples.buggy_output_reported: is_date_array_normalized is the one Localizer loop that does not skip NPY_NAT before shifting, so the NaT sentinel is shifted (wrapped / out-of-bounds read on the DST path with pos == -1) instead of short-circuiting.
